scenes.narration: An array idiom is more than a shorter spelling of a loop. It captures a pattern that keeps coming back. Once we see the pattern, we can reason about the whole operation. We can reuse it, and test it. Often we can make it faster, apart from the program that uses it. The goal is not to remove every loop. The goal is to say the problem at the most useful level.
